newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: NUM says branch official killed at Rusplat.
newsitem.headline: NUM says branch official killed at Rusplat.

text.p: South Africa's National Union of Mineworkers (NUM) said on Thursday that its branch secretary at Rustenburg Platinum Holdings Ltd, Rudwell Diale, was shot and killed on Wednesday night by unknown assailants.
Three balaclava-clad men entered Diale's room while he was asleep and shot him several times with a revolver before attempting to decapitate him with a butcher's knife, NUM said in a statement.
The mine, which has been plagued by a long-running dispute over union representation was hit late last month by a two-day wildcat strike affecting 15 percent of production.
NUM said the situation at the mine remained tense as police investigated the murder. No arrests have been made.
Last month an attempt was made on Diale's life when several shots were fired at him.
The NUM said it had made a submission to police officials calling for investigations into alleged incidences of torture of union officials, violence and intimidation at the mines.
Rusplats produced 690,000 ounces of platinum in the six months to December 1996.
